title: core.org.updated
description: An organization's settings changed. `changed` names the columns the update touched. `timezone`, `currency` and `fiscal_year_start_month` are the values *after* the change and are always present, so a projection that buckets by the organization's local day converges on the next event without reading account back.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I1): services/account/app/services.py:update_organization does not emit timezone, currency, fiscal_year_start_month yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
